summary: This directory serves as the foundation for the project's data persistence layer, encapsulating the logic required to interact with external storage systems, manage database connections, and handle raw data persistence operations.
responsibilities: Execute persistence operations for application entities
Coordinate data retrieval and storage processes
relationships: The persistence layer manages the lifecycle of database connections to ensure stable communication with storage systems.
Persistence operations utilize defined connection handlers to perform CRUD actions on application data.
designDecisions: Separation of concerns by isolating infrastructure storage logic from business services
Abstraction of database drivers to allow for storage engine flexibility
